result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Visualize the dependency graph of a solution or project

USAGE:
    projgraph visualize [path] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    projgraph visualize MySolution.sln
    projgraph visualize MySolution.sln --format tree
    projgraph visualize MySolution.slnx --output graph.mmd

ARGUMENTS:
    [path]    The path to the .sln, .slnx, or .csproj file

OPTIONS:
                                     DEFAULT                                    
    -h, --help                                  Prints help information         
    -f, --format                     mermaid    The output format (flat, tree,  
                                                mermaid)                        
        --show-title <TRUE|FALSE>    True       Include the diagram title       
                                                (default true)                  
        --include-packages                      Include NuGet package           
                                                dependencies in the graph       
    -o, --output <PATH>                         The output file path

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Generate a Mermaid ERD for an Entity Framework Core DbContext

USAGE:
    projgraph erd [path] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    projgraph erd Data/AppDbContext.cs
    projgraph erd Data/AppDbContext.cs --context BlogContext
    projgraph erd Data/AppDbContext.cs --output docs/erd.md

ARGUMENTS:
    [path]    Path to a .cs file containing a DbContext or ModelSnapshot        
              (optional, searches current directory if not specified)           

OPTIONS:
                                         DEFAULT                                
    -h, --help                                      Prints help information     
    -c, --context                                   The name of the DbContext or
                                                    ModelSnapshot to analyze    
                                                    (optional)                  
        --show-title <TRUE|FALSE>        True       Include the diagram title   
                                                    (default true)              
    -o, --output <PATH>                             The output file path        
        --owned-mode <MIRROR|CLASSIC>    mirror     How EF Core owned types are 
                                                    shown: 'mirror' inlines     
                                                    table-split owned types onto
                                                    the owner as EF names them  
                                                    (default), 'classic' gives  
                                                    every owned type its own    
                                                    entity

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Generate a Mermaid Class Diagram for a C# file

USAGE:
    projgraph classdiagram [path] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    projgraph classdiagram Services/UserService.cs
    projgraph classdiagram Models/User.cs --inheritance --dependencies --depth 
10
    projgraph classdiagram Models/User.cs --output user-hierarchy.mmd

ARGUMENTS:
    [path]    Path to the .cs file to analyze

OPTIONS:
                                     DEFAULT                                    
    -h, --help                                  Prints help information         
    -i, --inheritance                           Discover base classes and       
                                                interfaces in the workspace     
                                                (optional)                      
    -d, --dependencies                          Discover dependent types in the 
                                                workspace (optional)            
        --properties <TRUE|FALSE>    True       Show properties and fields in   
                                                the diagram (default true)      
        --functions <TRUE|FALSE>     True       Show functions and methods in   
                                                the diagram (default true)      
        --depth                      1          Max depth for relationship      
                                                discovery (default 1)           
        --show-title <TRUE|FALSE>    True       Include the diagram title       
                                                (default true)                  
    -o, --output <PATH>                         The output file path

Analyse a solution and print key architectural metrics

EXAMPLES:
    projgraph stats MySolution.slnx
    projgraph stats MySolution.slnx --top 10

ARGUMENTS:
    [path]    The path to the .sln, .slnx, or .csproj file

OPTIONS:
                     DEFAULT                                                    
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                         
        --top <N>    5          Number of most-referenced projects to show      
                                (default 5)
